title: scripts/test-all-locked.mjs installed its SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers after spawning vitest, so a signal in that gap killed the wrapper and stranded vitest and the lock; its signal tests waited on lines written before the handlers, and waitFor gave up silently
evidence: Handlers now go in before spawn() (scripts/test-all-locked.mjs main). scripts/test-all-locked.test.ts "a SIGTERM landing the moment vitest is spawned still reaches the handler" fails on the old order (exit null, not 143); waitFor throws naming what it waited for; the signal fakes write 'ready' after their handler.
